title: Entry
description: Append-only signed line. kit-meter points-contract signs: task_hold is negative; task_release is positive (refund); task_settlement is the consume-track net occupancy already applied by hold/release (delta 0 on consume settle; supplement is another hold, refund is release); usage_shortfall is a formal audit kind (delta 0, not an overdraft). Positive grant kinds open lots. A positive task_settlement records an earned grant; the contest-track winner payout is not emitted by the consume-track engine. expiry is negative when it burns opened, or zero when a held slice expires on release.
